summary: Iteration 2 (A.P.T.I.T.U.D.E. Oregon judicial platform) — all backend and frontend acceptance criteria pass. 10/10 pytest tests green, including the two new endpoints (/api/oregon-facts returns 6 Oregon facts incl. 211 judges & 380000 STOP stops; /api/actors and /api/actors?role=judge both return pending_dataset/count=0/actors=[]). Oregon-focused LLM search returns a proper Principle / Analysis / Proof Counsel's Brief with no regression of /api/, /api/status (POST/GET), or /api/searches. Frontend hero renders the full expanded acronym, embossed wordmark, borderless underline search bar, OregonCounter with 6 rotating dots, and 8 flip cards with correctly slugged data-testids (the-judiciary, the-watchtower, law-enforcement, community-corrections, bias-beacon, juris-lab, community, about-us). All 8 sub-page routes load via direct URL and via top-nav links; mobile menu toggle opens the full nav. /judiciary shows data-status-panel + judiciary-tiers-frame + judiciary-toolbar (search/filter/compare) + 9 judge-skeleton cards. /bias-beacon renders 4 beacon-panel mock charts (heatmap, bars, flow, pulse). Hero search submits a real query and the search-result-panel renders Markdown properly (bold Principle/Analysis/Proof labels + bulleted Proof list) — iteration 1's Markdown polish item is now fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is clean: async motor, _id excluded from projections, pending_dataset flag is a nice forward-compatible contract for /api/actors.
OREGON_FACTS is a module-level constant — fine for now; once live ingestion happens, move it to a collection with the same shape to avoid changing the response contract.

Frontend PagesGrid derives data-testid from page.title via lowercase + dash; for 'About Us' this yields 'about-us' but the route is '/about' — testid slug and route slug intentionally differ. Worth a comment in PAGES so a future contributor doesn't 'fix' it.

Hero search panel testids ('search-result-panel', 'hero-search-input', etc.) are consistent and well-placed for E2E. Counsel's Brief now uses a real Markdown renderer — addresses iteration 1's polish item.
Judiciary/BiasBeacon testids prefix consistently (judiciary-*, beacon-*, judge-skeleton-*). Recommend documenting these in a short TESTIDS.md to keep slugs stable across iterations.
No file exceeds the 700-line guideline now that Hero/SearchBar/OregonCounter/PagesGrid are split into /components/aptitude/*.
